key_insight: LaMoN$_3$ exhibits enhanced photovoltaic performance under pressure due to tunable linear and nonlinear optical responses.
engineering_relevance: This study contributes to the development of high-efficiency solar cells using nitride perovskite materials.
method: First-principles methods including density functional theory and many-body perturbation theory were utilized.
Systematic investigation of linear and nonlinear optical properties under pressures up to 40 GPa.
Assessment of phase stability and electronic structure tuning.
evidence_signal: LaMoN$_3$ shows a bandgap decrease from 2.17 eV to 1.45 eV as pressure increases, indicating a favorable adjustment in electronic properties.
watch_item: Further exploration is required to address the synthesis challenges and long-term stability of LaMoN$_3$ in practical applications.
paper_title: Harnessing Linear and Nonlinear Optical Responses in Ferroelectric LaMoN$_3$ for Enhanced Photovoltaic Efficiency
